name: Naka-Kon
blurb: Annual anime convention at the Overland Park Convention Center with voice actors, musicians, cosplay guests and a Japanese fashion/industry showcase.

editions.evidence: Homepage/guests page text: "Overland Park Convention Center | March 12-14, 2027"

notes: Refute pass (2026-10-05): trimmed 54 -> 1. naka-kon.com/guests/all turns out to be a cumulative, multi-year archive, not this edition's page -- the site has separate year-tagged pages (/guests/2025, /guests/2026, /guests/2027), discovered via the 'OTHER GUEST-RELATED LINKS' on a fresh render. /guests/2026 (the just-concluded prior edition) lists ~32 names that account for most of what 'all' showed (Heather Gonzalez, Xanthe Huynh, Aaron Roberts, Zeno Robinson, Jonah Scott, Maki Otsuki, PAiDA, Amelie Belcher, Ratty Creations, Iris Garden x Haenuli, Kazutaka Kodaka, Madison May, Sam Villanueva, Diana The Great/Diana Tolin, Duff Cosplay, Gingy Stitch, Hylian Cream, Kirilee, Malinda Chan, Turtle Smithy, Hiromi Sameshima, Luna Flare, Risque Revelry, Knotty Orchid, Annie-Mae Allure, Coco Royale, Eden Draconis, Eva Amora, Tiana Charming, Ulla La, plus Kayli Mills marked cancelled), while a full fresh Chromium render (with scroll/expand) of the dedicated /guests/2027 page -- the only page actually specific to this edition -- turned up exactly one guest, Ben Stegmair. He is kept, pointed at that dedicated 2027 render; the other 53 (including the handful not even on the 2026 page, likely 2025 or earlier) have no positive evidence of being booked for this edition and are dropped per RESEARCH.md ('keep only those' with proof).
